welcomeText: Hi! I’m TazaHat’s virtual assistant. Ask me about delivery, payments, or products. You can also try “order Rohu Fish x2”.
productWelcomeText: Hi! What would you like to know about {product}? Ask me about its freshness, size, or how to prepare it.
replyCancelled: Your demo order has been cancelled. No real order was placed.
replyNoActiveOrder: There isn’t an active demo order to cancel. You can still ask me about a product order.
replySupport: Hi! I’m Priya from the support team. I’ve received your message and will help review it. Please don’t share passwords or payment details here.
replyOrderSummary: Here’s your demo order summary. Please note that nothing has been purchased.
replyAskProduct: Which product would you like? Send a catalog item name, for example “order Rohu Fish - Fresh x2”.
replyDelivery: You can book a pickup and check delivery details on the Delivery Service page. For an existing order, open My Orders to check its latest status.
replyPayment: Payment options depend on the order. The available methods will be shown at checkout. For payment issues, type “talk to support” and a team member will reply.
replyTracking: For live order status, please open My Orders. This preview chat doesn’t have access to real order or delivery data.
replyFallback: I can help with product orders, cancellations, delivery, and payment questions. For a person, type “talk to support”.
demoNotice: Sample chat only · Orders are not purchased or sent.
demoOrderDisclaimer: Demo only · Not a real purchase
